mavzu: UNIT 6 LESSON 1 - What did you do yesterday?

savollar.savol: "Watch TV" nimani anglatadi?
"Have a shower" nimani anglatadi?
"Buy a book" nimani anglatadi?
"Do homework" nimani anglatadi?
"Brush teeth" nimani anglatadi?
"Help mother" kimga yordamlashni anglatadi?
"Go fishing" nimani anglatadi?
"Play chess" nimani anglatadi?
"Interesting" sifati nimani anglatadi?
"Boring" sifati O'zbekchada nima anglatadi?
"It was fun" desa, faoliyat qanday bo'lganligini anglatadi?
"It was boring" desa, faoliyat haqida nima aytilmoqda?
"It was great" desa, bu nima demekdir?
Teatrga borganda, siz nima qilasiz?
Bogda ishlash qanday turi faoliyatdir?
"Did you watch TV?" savolida qaysi tense shakli ishlatilmoqda?
"I took the rubbish out" jumlasida past tense verbni aniqlang.
"Get washed" va "have a shower" o'rtasidagi farq nima?
variantlar: Birinchisi yuzni yuvish, ikkinchisi butun tana yuvish

savollar.savol: Matnda "play the ___" quyidagi qaysi asboblarni o'z ichiga oladi?
"Do the washing" nimani anglatadi?
Agar biri "What did you do yesterday?" sorasa va siz "We went to the theatre" javob versangiz, u "What did you do there?" desa, siz qanday javob berasiz?
"It was interesting" va "It was boring" ifodalarning asosiy farqi nima?
variantlar: Birinchisi ijobiy, ikkinchisi salbiy ma'noni anglatadi

savollar.savol: Dialoqda "Did you play computer games?" savolga "Yes" javob berib, keyin u "How was it?" desa, siz qanday javob berasiz?
"Miming" o'yni qanday qoidada o'ynanadi?
variantlar: Bitta kishi faoliyatni ko'rsatadi, boshqalari topadi

savollar.savol: "Went" qaysi verbning past tense shaklidir?
"Play the piano" va "play the rubob" ikkalasi qaysi guruha kiradi?
Dialogda "A: What did you do yesterday? B: We went to... A: What did you do there?" - bu pattern qanday faoliyat bilaniga asoslangan?
Matnda berilgan sifatlardan qaysilari musbat ma'noni anglatadi?
Pair work davomida dialogni kimlar o'ynaymiz?
variantlar: Ikkala talaba ham gapiradi - A va B rol o'ynaymiz

savollar.savol: Agar "work in the garden" qilgan bo'lsangiz va "It was interesting" desangiz, bu nima demekni anglatadi?
variantlar: Bogda ishlash qiziq va o'ylab ko'rilgan edi
